build_dfine_object_detection_model: build a DFineForObjectDetection model for object detection using pretrained weights from ustk-community/dfine-xlarge-coco
configure_dfine_model: configure a DFineConfig with custom encoder, decoder, and loss hyperparameters for object detection
run_dfine_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a DFineForObjectDetection model with image inputs to get bounding box predictions
refine_bounding_box_predictions: refine bounding box predictions using DFineDecoder with fine-grained distribution refinement and location quality estimation
initialize_dfine_model_weights: initialize DFine model weights with proper bias priors, sampling offsets, and attention weight initialization
